description: Check whether an IP address really belongs to the crawler it claims to be, against the ranges the operator publishes. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, Perplexity and Apple all publish these. Answers verified, impostor, or unverifiable, and never says impostor without positive evidence: if the operator publishes nothing, or the feed fails to load, the answer is unverifiable. Use when a log line looks suspicious or before allow-listing anything by name.

bot.description: The crawler it claims to be, e.g. GPTBot

ip.description: The client IP address from your log

name: aeo_verify_crawler
